subject: Tri-region dedicated capacity proposal and onboarding timeline
messages:
From: Sophie Carter <sophie@acme.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask for enterprise onboarding (3 regions)

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed internally, Acme is ready to move a pilot of our conversational agent into production and we need a firm proposal for dedicated capacity across US / EU / APAC. Primary constraints: PII residency in EU, low latency for APAC customers, and predictable throughput for US peak hours.

Attached is a short CSV with our projected QPS and token distribution by region for the first 12 months (initial_usage_estimate.csv). High level asks:
- Can you size a dedicated pool per region (reserved + burst)?
- Which GPU families would you recommend for our mix (real-time chat + embeddings + reranking)?
- Rough lead time for reserving capacity / any procurement cadence we should plan for.

We have a budget guardrail but are prioritizing SLA and regional residency for now. Happy to jump on a call — would next Tuesday 10am PT work?

Sophie
Sophie Carter
Head of AI Products | Acme AI
Acme AI, Inc.
Attachment: initial_usage_estimate.csv (CSV, 14KB)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Carter <sophie@acme.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask for enterprise onboarding (3 regions)

Sophie —

Thanks for the CSV, that was very helpful. I pulled together an initial tri-region proposal (attached: proposed_capacity_plan.xlsx) and sketched a tentative timeline. High-level recommendations below — these are conservative reserves we can convert to a committed pool with a 12-month reserve.

Proposed reserved capacity (initial committed pool):
- US (primary traffic): 16 x H100 (full precision inference preferred); burst up to +8 H100 on dedicated burst layer (autoscale policy). Estimated sustained throughput: ~120 tokens/sec aggregate at p95 during peak, supports real-time chat with 80ms per-token target for smaller models.
- EU (data residency): 8 x A100 80GB (or H100 if residency performance requirement demands); separate VPC/private plane option. Burst +4 A100.
- APAC (low-latency edge): 4 x H100 (or 8 x A100 for cost balance) in our singapore region private pool; burst +2.

Operational notes:
- We recommend enabling KV prefix caching and a small 10-20% token cache hit expectation for typical chat flows to reduce baseline cost.
- Model family assumption: 70B-class llama/opt variants (quantized to int8 for cost) for embeddings/rerank heavier flows; customer-supplied 30B for low-latency chat if they want lower latency.
- Estimated monthly committed spend (ballpark): US: $X/month, EU: $Y/month, APAC: $Z/month — I’ll get precise numbers from Finance once capacity confirms availability.

Next steps / asks from Acme:
1) Confirm preferred GPU preference per region (H100 vs A100) — affects lead time.
2) Confirm whether EU must be private plane (VPC) vs hosted but EU-only.
3) Sign SOW draft to lock 12-month committed discount (attached SOW_draft_v1.pdf).

We can hold the proposed pool for ~2 weeks pending SOW signature; procurement timelines will affect start date. Proposed call: Tue 12 May 10am PT to walk the numbers (I’ve tentatively blocked it).

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142
Attachment: proposed_capacity_plan.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Dedicated capacity ask for enterprise onboarding (3 regions)

Team —

Forwarding Acme's request and my initial proposal. TL;DR: Acme wants committed pools in US/EU/APAC with a 12-month commitment. Numbers above in the attached ask. Need confirmation on two fronts: availability and lead time for H100/A100 in each region, and whether we can offer the separate EU private-control-plane option with the staffing SLA they’ll ask for.

Specific asks:
- Vivek: can you confirm fleet availability / procurement lead time for 16 H100 in us-west, 8 A100 in eu-west, and 4 H100 in ap-southeast? If H100 is constrained we should propose A100 fallbacks per my email to Sophie. Also call out any outage/redundancy recommendations (cross-AZ pools).
- Karthik: pricing/finance — if they sign for 12-month commit, what discount band applies for this mix? I called it X/Y/Z in the sheet but that’s a placeholder. Need formal band to include in SOW.
- Grace (solutions): any operational concerns for EU residency / VPC private plane that would add time/cost? They specifically flagged regulatory constraints for logs retention and region-only processing.

Timeline: procurement + capacity provisioning typically ~4–8 weeks depending on GPU availability and region. If we can validate availability this week we can give Acme a firm start date and push SOW.

Thanks — please reply with availability and any redlines by EOD Wednesday so I can update the SOW and confirm the call with Acme.

— Lauren

From: Sophie Carter <sophie@acme.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask for enterprise onboarding (3 regions)

Thanks Lauren — that proposal looks reasonable and aligns with our internal sizing. A few quick clarifications before we sign:
- Can Redwood commit to a regional SLA (p99 latency under committed pool) and a monthly uptime SLA per region?
- For EU residency, we need a SOC2+GDPR attestation and confirmation that logs and KV cache never leave the eu-west region.
- Procurement: we need a draft SOW and a procurement-friendly invoice schedule (milestone-based).

We’re ready to move quickly if you can confirm availability. If H100 lead time is >4 weeks, we’re OK with a hybrid approach (start with A100 + migrate to H100).

I’ll brief Procurement and loop them on the SOW once you send it. Call still good for tomorrow at 10am PT if you want to walk the plan.

Sophie
Sophie Carter
Head of AI Products | Acme AI
Attachment: none
